about: check-size.mts --budgets: gzip bytes the browser downloads, per class, from dist/ after npm run build. A size over its budget fails; a size more than 5% under fails until the budget is lowered, so budgets only go down. Set 2026-11-04 from the fork's main at about 1% over the measured size. 2026-11-05: lazy raised from 3055000 to 3055261 (measured 3055251 at 2f33440): #208 added 229 B of lazy JS (call sites for the deferred heli load; boot and entry did not change) and later PRs the rest. 2026-11-05: boot raised from 1168020 to 1168070 for a context-restore correctness fix (#214): engine.contextLost also reads gl.isContextLost(), and the engine skips initTexture and warmDraw while the context is lost (Captain-approved exception).
